about.title: About the Metal Raiders set
paragraphs: Metal Raiders is a Yu-Gi-Oh! TCG booster set released on 26 June 2002, in the Duel Monsters era. It has 144 cards, and with the 2 other rarities there are 146 to collect in all.
Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 144 cards, each in its main rarity) or the Master set (all 146, adding the 2 other rarities).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details and images come from YGOPRODeck, and prices from TCGplayer.
